patch.value: One shared tracker-initialization guard: 48 sites re-implement resolvePmRoot plus a settings probe plus the same literal refusal, so every precision fix has to be applied 48 times and never is

A single SDK guard owns the tracker-initialization refusal and all 48 call sites delegate to it; The guard distinguishes root-missing, root-is-a-file, and settings-missing, and each carries its own recovery; The recovery for root-is-a-file does not suggest pm init, which cannot succeed against a regular file; The surface-replication gate declares this set so a 49th hand-rolled copy fails CI

## The population

`grep -rn "Run pm init first" src/ --include=*.ts | grep -v test` returns **48** sites. Each one repeats the same three steps:

```ts
const pmRoot = resolvePmRoot(process.cwd(), global.path);
if (!(await pathExists(getSettingsPath(pmRoot)))) {
  throw new PmCliError(`Tracker is not initialized at ${pmRoot}. Run pm init first.`, EXIT_CODE.NOT_FOUND);
}
```

## Why it matters beyond tidiness

The refusal is not merely duplicated, it is **imprecise in a way that cannot be fixed cheaply**. Three distinct states collapse into one message:

- the root does not exist
- the root exists but is a regular file
- the root is a directory with no settings

Only the third is repairable by `pm init`, yet all three recommend it. pm-tmhs already closed one shape of this defect (recovery re-suggested `pm init` when a `--pm-path` tracker existed). The class recurred in a new shape - discovered via pm-6xlyss, where a root that is a regular file still recommends `pm init`. It will keep recurring while the guard has 48 owners.

## Shape of the fix

`core/store/item-store.ts` already contains the precise logic: `assertItemMetadataRoot` distinguishes `tracker_root_missing`, `tracker_root_not_directory`, and walks ancestors to attribute the cause. That analysis is the right one and is already tested. It is simply not what the 48 entrypoints call.

Promote it to a single SDK guard, delegate all 48 sites, and declare the set in the surface-replication gate so a 49th copy fails CI rather than review.

Promote tracker-initialization detection into one public SDK guard and migrate the 48 hand-rolled CLI call sites to it. The shared primitive must distinguish missing roots, file collisions, and missing settings with precise recovery and a static replication gate.
